title: Global Retirement Quarterly Update - Writing for the CEO's Signature
situation: Global Retirement needed a consistent quarterly business update for bulletins, town halls, and leadership communications across regions.
obstacle: The update had to carry the CEO's voice, satisfy Communications on format and distribution, and be accurate enough on performance to survive scrutiny from the regional leaders it described.
actions: Drafted the Global Retirement quarterly business update used for bulletins, town halls, and leadership communications
Worked directly with Communications on production, format, and distribution
Carried the draft through review and approval by the CEO of Retirement before finalization
results: Established a consistent quarterly communication for the global retirement business
Produced executive communication reviewed and approved at CEO level
fullStory: In the AVP Finance and Strategy Advisory role I was responsible for drafting the Global Retirement quarterly business update used for bulletins, town halls, and leadership communications. I worked with Communications on production and distribution, and the CEO of Retirement reviewed and approved it before it was finalized. Writing something that goes out under a CEO's name is a different discipline from writing analysis. The judgment is what to leave out.
